hero.title: Know when they need you.
hero.subtitle: Stop guessing. A sensor in the soil reads moisture on its own Wi-Fi — no extra hub, no standing next to the plant. You get a nudge when it's time to water, even when you're away.

highlights.title: Three things that change how you care for them.
highlights.lead: Less guessing, no extra box to set up, and a reminder that follows you.

moisture.title: Stop guessing when to water
moisture.body: The probe reads the soil, so you water only when the plant actually needs it — not when the surface looks dry.

wifi.title: No hub. Just your Wi-Fi.
wifi.body: Each sensor connects on its own. One plant or a whole windowsill. It keeps working when you're not in the room — and when you're not at home.

weather.title: Indoors, balcony, or garden
weather.body: Use it in the house or outside. When rain is coming, outdoor plants can wait.

household.title: Someone at home can water for you.
household.body: Alerts can land in a household Telegram group — the chat you already use. Basil is thirsty; whoever is home picks up the watering can.

telegramSetup.accordionTitle: How to set up Telegram notifications
telegramSetup.step1Body: Open Telegram and search for <link>@userinfobot</link>. Tap <bold>Start</bold> — it will immediately reply with your numeric Chat ID (e.g. 123456789).
telegramSetup.step2Title: Start a conversation with the Plantir bot
telegramSetup.step2Body: Search for <link>@PlantirAlert_bot</link> in Telegram and tap <bold>Start</bold>. This is required so Telegram allows the bot to send you messages.
telegramSetup.step3Title: Enter your Chat ID below and verify
telegramSetup.step3Body: Paste the number from Step 1 into the Telegram Chat ID field. The name of your account should appear below the field — confirm it is the right person or group, then pick your preferred notification time and save.
telegramSetup.webTipBody: Copying the Chat ID is easier in a browser. Open <web>Telegram Web</web>, start @userinfobot there, then copy the number.
telegramSetup.groupTitle: Want alerts for multiple people? Use a group
telegramSetup.groupBody: Start a conversation with <userinfobot>@userinfobot</userinfobot> and choose one of your groups when prompted — the bot will reply with that group's Chat ID (a negative number, e.g. -1001234567890). Then add <link>@PlantirAlert_bot</link> to the group so it can send messages there. Paste the group ID in the field below — the group name will appear for you to confirm — and everyone in the group will receive the alerts.

setupCode.title: Setup code
setupCode.intro: Copy this setup code. You will paste it into the sensor Wi-Fi portal in the next steps.

connect.title: Connect to sensor hotspot
connect.copyCodeFirst: Make sure the setup code from the previous step is copied.
connect.openCap: Slightly twist the cap of the sensor counter-clockwise, then pull it up.
connect.pressRestart: Press the <bold>RESTART</bold> button on the side of the sensor. After you press it, the chip inside the Plantir sensor will light a green LED three times in a row. The sensor will then open a Wi-Fi hotspot named <bold>Plantir-Device-Setup</bold>.
connect.connectHotspot: On your phone or computer, connect to <bold>Plantir-Device-Setup</bold> hotspot. A portal will open automatically — it should look like this:
connect.configureWifi: Tap <bold>Configure WiFi</bold>, then select your home network, enter the password.
connect.waitPortalClose: Paste the setup code into the <bold>Plantir Setup</bold> field and tap <bold>Save</bold>. Wait for the <bold>Plantir-Device-Setup</bold> portal to close automatically.

waiting.ownedByAnother: This sensor is already registered to a different account. If you believe this is your sensor, contact support.
waiting.registrationFailed: Registration failed. Please try again or contact support.

calibrationWizard.title: Calibrate sensor

prepare.title: Before you start
prepare.intro: Calibration teaches the sensor what "completely dry" and "completely wet" feel like, so it can give you accurate soil moisture readings.

wake.title: Wake the sensor
wake.instructions: Slightly twist the cap counter-clockwise, then pull it up. Press the <bold>Restart</bold> button on your Plantir sensor to wake it up. After you press it, the chip inside the Plantir sensor will light a green LED three times in a row. Then put the cap back on.
wake.timeout: No reading received. Make sure you pressed the restart button and the sensor connected to Wi-Fi.
wake.waiting: Waiting for the sensor to connect…

dry.title: Dry reading
dry.instructions: Hold the black sensor tip in open air, away from any soil or water. Hold position while we capture a stable reading.
dry.timeout: No reading received. Make sure you pressed the restart button and the sensor connected to Wi-Fi.
dry.rejected: Make sure the black sensor tip is in open air, away from any soil or water, then hold still.

wet.title: Wet reading
wet.instructions: Gently lower the sensor into the glass of water until the white horizontal line on the black tip is just submerged. Hold the sensor steady at this depth while we capture a stable reading.
wet.guideAlt: Sensor submerge in water up to the white horizontal line
wet.timeout: No reading received. Make sure the sensor is submerged correctly and the sensor is still connected.
wet.rejected: Make sure the sensor tip is submerged in water down to the white horizontal line, without submerging the rest of the sensor.
